podcast.title: Success and Ben Lovett's Departure (2007)
podcast.body: By October 2007, Hot Rocket was a successful indie band with a well-reviewed EP and a sold-out UK tour, but Ben Lovett made the tough decision to leave the band, its record deal, and tour to join the new "foaky thing" (proto-Mumford & Sons) that had formed in his own club. "But Ben was having a better time playing with these other three guys."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Ben Lovett Leaves Hot Rocket for Mumford & Sons (2007)
xref.body: In October 2007, despite his band Hot Rocket having a successful indie EP and a sold-out UK tour, Ben Lovett chose to leave Hot Rocket, his record deal, and the tour to join the nascent "foaky thing" that would become Mumford & Sons, feeling a stronger connection to their music. "So he made a decision."
